title: Jumbo Flaky Norwegian Pastry Casserole
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring layers of flaky pastry, rich filling, and a hint of cream of tartar, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is egg-free-friendly and sure to become a family favorite.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: chilled and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cream of tartar, and salt.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the cold water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a separate bowl, combine the sliced apples and brown sugar.
Spread half of the apple mixture over the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the casserole in a 9x13 inch baking dish and brush the top with heavy cream.
Bake the casserole for 40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is tender.
